Description & Content
description
duration: 1 Hour meeting_point: Arataki Lavender Farm: 38 Pawsons Valley Road, Duvauchelle 7581, New Zealand group_size: Maximum 10 guests accessibility: Uneven ground with potential hazards such as rabbit holes, uneven terrain, or calves in paddocks. Activity not suitable for individuals under the influence of drugs or alcohol. description: Explore regenerating forests on a two-hour guided tour, learn about efforts to restore the land to its pre-European tunga (situation), and enjoy optional forest picnics, complimentary tea, and lavender products. Experience a one-hour guided tour of the conservation aspects of the property from October to March. The story of our efforts to return the property to its pre-European tunga, are shared as you explore the regenerating forest. The opportunity to purchase lavender products made from our lavender is available on this experience. This experience includes complimentary afternoon tea. what_is_included: Afternoon tea made the traditional way with fire (fire conditions allowing) and real tea/coffee. Classic New Zealand/Aotearoa biscuit. Opportunity to purchase lavender products, made from our lavender. what_is_not_included: Opportunity to purchase lavender products made from our lavender. itinerary: Guided experience by genuine kiwis! Explore regenerating forest. Explore sustainably grown forest (cypress). Explore lavender fields (note plants not flowering during this tours operation). Engage with plants (may involve tasting native species) Experience stunning views of Akaroa harbour Enjoy scrumptious afternoon tea made the genuine way. highlights: Join your experienced guide for a two-hour walk through native and introduced forest and lavender fields: with stunning views over Akaroa harbour. Learn about our journey which has seen the farm transformed from three open grass paddocks to a place with over 35,000 native plants and a wide range of bird species. Experience native bird songs, understand the importance and use of native plants and how we work to protect the mauri (life force) of this place. End your experience with a genuine kiwi afternoon tea, made the old fashioned way! We look forward to welcoming you as we share our journey to a sustainable future. check_in_details: Guests should arrive 5 minutes before the tour start time what_to_bring: Appropriate footwear for uneven terrain. special_requirements: Guests must be physically capable of the activity. This includes walking up and down gentle slopes on good tracks. Contact Akaroa Lavender if needing to update booking details or discuss specific circumstances for cancellation/postponement. restrictions: No smoking, no illegal substances, and no pets. Follow team instructions at all times. Avoid touching electric fences, traps, or native stinging plants. extras: ##Languages: - English, Cantonese, Mandarin and Malay. disclaimers: Risks include encounters with electric fences, traps, stinging plants, wasps, uneven ground, and curious calves. faqs: 1. Is it safe to touch the fences or traps? No, electric fences and traps should not be touched for safety reasons. 2. What happens if I cancel my booking? Refund policies depend on timing: More than 7 days in advance: Refund (minus fees). Within 7 days: No refund unless under special circumstances. 3. Are pets allowed? No pets are permitted. 4. What happens if the weather is bad? In case of extreme weather or natural disasters, Akaroa Lavender will provide alternatives or refunds.

detail_description
Explore regenerating forests on a two-hour guided tour, learn about efforts to restore the land to its pre-European tunga (situation), and enjoy optional forest picnics, complimentary tea, and lavender products. Experience a one-hour guided tour of the conservation aspects of the property from October to March. The story of our efforts to return the property to its pre-European tunga, are shared as you explore the regenerating forest. The opportunity to purchase lavender products made from our lavender is available on this experience. This experience includes complimentary afternoon tea.
detail_highlights
Explore regenerating forests on a two-hour guided tour. Learn about efforts to restore the land to its pre-European tunga. Enjoy optional forest picnics, complimentary tea, and lavender products.
detail_itinerary
Experience a one-hour guided tour of the conservation aspects of the property from October to March.

Optional forest picnics are not included.

Description & Content
description
duration: 2.5 Hours meeting_point: Departing from the Port Chalmers Cruise Terminal group_size: Maximum 16 people accessibility: Not suitable for wheelchairs description: # Find out why Dunedin is the Wildlife Capital of NZ! We’ll pick you up from the Port Chalmers Cruise Ship Terminal and shuttle you 5-minutes to our boat, the Vivienne J. Once aboard the boat our local crew of nature enthusiasts will take you for a Wildlife Cruise on the Otago Harbour and beyond. The small-group cruise will travel past beautiful wharves, boatsheds and the historic Quarantine Island. You’ll see the Careys Bay fishing village and its motley collection of fishing boats before continuing down the harbour. Your crew will put the kettle on and offer you a hot drink and biscuit for morning tea. As you arrive at the entrance to the Otago Harbour you’ll see the tidal Aramoana sandflats and the spectacular volcanic cliffs of Taiaroa Head. You’ll see the royal albatross breeding colony, the only mainland colony in the world. Beneath a picturesque lighthouse you’ll find a large population of fur seals, watch as they swim, play and sleep on rocky platforms close to the boat. A short way out to sea we often spot other species of albatross and seabirds. We sometimes get lucky and see dolphins, sea lions and blue penguins. ## What to bring: Dress warm for the days forecast and bring a waterproof layer. The weather can be unpredictable at times and we highly recommend being ready for all conditions. Extra jackets are available if needed. We suggest wearing sturdy and comfortable footwear. You are welcome to bring your own food and drink on the boat. Don’t forget your camera! check_in_details: Make your way to the ‘Private Tours Area’ within the Port Chalmers Cruise Ship Terminal. It is located approximately 100-metres from where you disembark your ship. You will be collected by a member of our team holding a MONARCH sign. Once everyone booked has arrived they'll shuttle you around to our wharf to board the MV Vivienne J. At the end of the tour you'll be dropped back at the Port Chalmers Cruise Terminal.

detail_description
Find out why Dunedin is the Wildlife Capital of NZ! We’ll pick you up from the Port Chalmers Cruise Ship Terminal and shuttle you 5-minutes to our boat, the Vivienne J. Once aboard the boat our local crew of nature enthusiasts will take you for a Wildlife Cruise on the Otago Harbour and beyond. The small-group cruise will travel past beautiful wharves, boatsheds and the historic Quarantine Island. You’ll see the Careys Bay fishing village and its motley collection of fishing boats before continuing down the harbour. Your crew will put the kettle on and offer you a hot drink and biscuit for morning tea. As you arrive at the entrance to the Otago Harbour you’ll see the tidal Aramoana sandflats and the spectacular volcanic cliffs of Taiaroa Head. You’ll see the royal albatross breeding colony, the only mainland colony in the world. Beneath a picturesque lighthouse you’ll find a large population of fur seals, watch as they swim, play and sleep on rocky platforms close to the boat. A short way out to sea we often spot other species of albatross and seabirds. We sometimes get lucky and see dolphins, sea lions and blue penguins. What to bring: Dress warm for the days forecast and bring a waterproof layer. The weather can be unpredictable at times and we highly recommend being ready for all conditions. Extra jackets are available if needed. We suggest wearing sturdy and comfortable footwear. You are welcome to bring your own food and drink on the boat. Don’t forget your camera!
detail_highlights
See the royal albatross breeding colony, the only mainland colony in the world. Watch fur seals swim, play, and sleep on rocky platforms close to the boat. Spot other species of albatross and seabirds, and occasionally dolphins, sea lions, and blue penguins.
detail_itinerary
We’ll pick you up from the Port Chalmers Cruise Ship Terminal and shuttle you 5-minutes to our boat, the Vivienne J. Once aboard the boat our local crew of nature enthusiasts will take you for a Wildlife Cruise on the Otago Harbour and beyond. The small-group cruise will travel past beautiful wharves, boatsheds and the historic Quarantine Island. You’ll see the Careys Bay fishing village and its motley collection of fishing boats before continuing down the harbour. As you arrive at the entrance to the Otago Harbour you’ll see the tidal Aramoana sandflats and the spectacular volcanic cliffs of Taiaroa Head.

booking_notes
##Thank you for booking a Otago Harbour Wildlife Cruise. ___ *High quality binoculars and multi-language information sheets will be provided aboard the cruise.* *Dress warm for the days forecast and bring a waterproof layer. The weather can be unpredictable at times and we highly recommend being ready for all conditions. Extra jackets are available if needed.* *We suggest wearing sturdy and comfortable footwear. If you decide to stand whilst on the boat always have a hand free to stabilise yourself on a rail. Take extra care when moving around the vessel.* *The area we cruise around is fairly sheltered from swell, however some wind and tide combinations can cause a little rock and roll. Don’t worry if the forecast is for a cold, wet or windy day, the albatross love it. They won’t stop for rain and neither do we. The best viewing often comes from the wilder days.* *Wildlife viewing isn’t guaranteed, but we’ll always aim to provide the best possible experience.* *Toilet and bathroom facilities are available during the Wildlife Cruise* *If you are concerned about potential sea sickness, a variety of preventative medications can be purchased at local pharmacies. Our crew can also provide pressure pressure point wristbands and peppermint oil pads if you begin to feel queasy or uneasy (they really do help).* You may be photographed and/or videotaped during your cruise or tour. Your image may be used for promotional and informational purposes, including online publications/media and tour documentation The recording of videography and or photography for the purposes of commercial gain is expressly forbidden without prior written permission from management. --- [View Otago Harbour Wildlife Cruise.pdf](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/VQhPh4MRwCGREolAwxGI)
booking_notes_safe_html
Thank you for booking a Otago Harbour Wildlife Cruise. High quality binoculars and multi-language information sheets will be provided aboard the cruise. Dress warm for the days forecast and bring a waterproof layer. The weather can be unpredictable at times and we highly recommend being ready for all conditions. Extra jackets are available if needed. We suggest wearing sturdy and comfortable footwear. If you decide to stand whilst on the boat always have a hand free to stabilise yourself on a rail. Take extra care when moving around the vessel. The area we cruise around is fairly sheltered from swell, however some wind and tide combinations can cause a little rock and roll. Don’t worry if the forecast is for a cold, wet or windy day, the albatross love it. They won’t stop for rain and neither do we. The best viewing often comes from the wilder days. Wildlife viewing isn’t guaranteed, but we’ll always aim to provide the best possible experience. Toilet and bathroom facilities are available during the Wildlife Cruise If you are concerned about potential sea sickness, a variety of preventative medications can be purchased at local pharmacies. Our crew can also provide pressure pressure point wristbands and peppermint oil pads if you begin to feel queasy or uneasy (they really do help). You may be photographed and/or videotaped during your cruise or tour. Your image may be used for promotional and informational purposes, including online publications/media and tour documentation The recording of videography and or photography for the purposes of commercial gain is expressly forbidden without prior written permission from management. View Otago Harbour Wildlife Cruise.pdf
cancellation_policy
We will arrange a full refund if your ship doesn’t arrive in Dunedin, or if it is late to berth and you miss the tour. Cancellations made more than 24 hours prior to the scheduled tour start time will be given a full refund. Any cancellations within 24 hours will not be issued a refund. If we cancel the tour for any reason (e.g inclement weather) we will provide a full refund.

Description & Content
description
Moreton Island is a unique paradise of golden beaches, rolling surf and beautiful freshwater lakes. Join Sunset Safaris as we explore and snorkel the stunning Tangalooma Shipwrecks, and see the shipwrecks in our very unique “Transparent Kayaks.” Experience the exhilaration of sliding down the giant sand dunes of “The Desert” up to 70 km/h. Moreton Island is one of the great ADVENTURE DESTINATIONS in Australia, and with Sunset Safaris you will experience the very best natural attractions this world-famous Island has to offer. Our award-nominated Tour Guides are tour professionals, with an intimate knowledge of Moreton Island’s unique attractions. We have become famous in Queensland for our love for fun, and that’s why Sunset Safaris is the “People’s Choice” tour company. Our mission is to make your visit to Moreton Island more than just a beautiful place to go, but an “Experience to Remember.”Australian Sunset Safaris are the FIRST to pioneer “Transparent Kayaks” in Queensland and around the Tangalooma Shipwrecks. See fish and coral like never before without having to go under the water. Our 1-Day Tour of Moreton Island takes in the very best activities and scenery the western side of this beautiful Island has to offer during the day. Jam packed full of fun, you can experience Sand Tobogganing, Snorkeling and swimming, 4WDing along the beach and sand tracks, Transparent Kayaking over shipwrecks and much more. This is the ULTIMATE ECO Adventure Day Tour in Queensland.

detail_highlights
["Enjoy a beautiful cruise across the magnificent Moreton Bay on the MiCat Ferry with air-conditioned comfort with cafe and bar facilities", "Relax on the beach at the Tangalooma Wrecks and have fun in the sun", "Enjoy a fully guided snorkelling tour of the Tangalooma Wrecks", "See turtles, dolphins, coral and thousands of beautiful reef fish", "Discover the hidden underwater wonders of the Tangalooma Wrecks with our fully guided Transparent Kayaks", "Experience the awesome FISH FRENZY in the Transparent Kayaks", "Feel the exhilaration of sand tobogganing at speeds of up to 70km/h", "Experience a 4WD adventure in our 4WD “Tough Bus” as we travel the rugged 4WD tracks of Moreton Island to “The Desert”", "Swim the crystal-clear beaches of Tangalooma Beach"]

POB National Park and Ferry Fees (To be paid in cash upon departure). Per person Adult AUD $80 and Children 13 years and under AUD $60. Pick-up and Drop-off in different regions attract additional fees.

Water bottle, swimwear, sunscreen, beach towel, hat, camera, flip flops/thongs, walking shoes and insect repellant.

detail_booking_notes
Please note that during the month of April and May 2025 pick-up times will vary due to a change to the ferry schedule. Pick-up options: Gold Coast: Departs 05:45 from Mantra on View Hotel (22 View Ave, Surfers Paradise QLD 4217). April 17th and 18th 2025 pick-up will be 07:30. April 20th to 22nd and 27th 2025 pick up will be 07:00. All other dates in April pick-up will be 05:30. 5th May 2025 pick-up will be 07:15. All other dates in May 2025 pick-up is 05:30. Brisbane: Departs 07:00 Brisbane Coach Terminal, Parkland Crescent QLD 4000. April 17th and 18th 2025 pick-up will be 09:00. April 20th to 22nd and 27th 2025 pick up will be 08:30. All other dates in April pick-up will be 07:00. 5th May 2025 pick-up will be 08:45. All other dates in May 2025 pick-up is 07:00. Departs 07:30 Port of Brisbane (14 Howard Smith Dr, Port of Brisbane QLD 4178). April 17th and 18th 2025 pick-up will be 10:00. April 20th to 22nd and 27th 2025 pick up will be 09:30. All other dates in April pick-up will be 07:30. 5th May 2025 pick-up will be 09:45. All other dates in May 2025 pick-up is 07:30. | Drop-off in Brisbane at 18:30 and Gold Coast at 19:30. Return times are approximate and subject to ferry schedule and traffic conditions. Please note that during the month of April and May 2025 drop-off times will vary due to a change to the ferry schedule. | The minimum age is 4 years. Unsuitable for toddlers, Child rates apply for 13 years and under. Suitable for people of all fitness levels. In cases of dangerous or poor weather conditions and rain, a scenic tour of the island may be conducted in place of affected activities. The itinerary is subject to times and weather conditions. Small carry-on luggage only. Small overnight bag restrictions apply(40cm wide x 30cm deep x 60cm high). No refunds for COVID No Show. Pickup and Drop off in different regions attract additional fees (POA). All prices are subject to change without notice & at the discretion of Sunset Safaris. All information stated in this publication is true & correct at the time of publication. Due to traffic, & the extreme conditions experienced on Moreton Island to buses & the environment, Sunset Safaris reserves the right to alter or cancel any section of the itinerary which may result from road, traffic, weather, mechanical, or any other condition or failure or delay of an operational nature without penalty, & such conditions will be considered as a Force Majeure Event. Sunset Safaris will take all reasonable steps to rectify the situation during any such event, however, no liability will be accepted by Sunset Safaris in circumstances outside of Sunset Safaris' control. No responsibility or liability will be taken in the event of injury from pre-existing medical conditions (eg: bad back), accident, injury, loss or damage to persons or property due to persons' own negligence. These booking conditions do not waive Sunset Safaris from any of its obligations according to law. Minimum booking numbers & cancellation fees apply. | A fuel levy may be applied if fuel rises above $2.50 per litre. A $20 AUD surcharge applies to all tours operating during Christmas/New Year & Easter Periods. $20 AUD surcharge (Cash or Credit Card) payable directly to Sunset Safaris on all gazetted holidays in Australia.

Description & Content
description
Tour 3C: Kakadu National Park Night Tour - 'Yellow Water River Cruise': Nature, Culture, and Wildlife An unforgettable journey from Darwin to Kakadu National Park, where nature’s wonders unfold before your eyes. This breathtaking bus tour takes you through landscapes that evolve from the wild expanse of tropical savannahs to the vibrant wetlands teeming with life. Your adventure begins with a peaceful stroll through either Fogg Damm or Mamukala Wetlands, both an avian paradise brimming with colorful birdlife—a dream come true for photographers and nature lovers alike, followed by lunch at Corroboree Tavern Next, immerse yourself in the rich cultural heritage of Kakadu at the Bowali Aboriginal Cultural Centre, where you’ll uncover the deep stories, spiritual connections, and traditions of the region’s Traditional Owners. Continue your exploration with a visit to the ancient Ngoulrlangie (Nourlangie) Rock Art Site, where the vivid rock paintings offer a window into the Dreaming, telling stories of ancestors that have lived for millennia. As the day winds down, prepare for the highlight of your journey: the Yellow Water River Cruise at sunset. Watch in awe as the golden light transforms the landscape, with birds soaring overhead, crocodiles gliding silently through the water, and reflections that shimmer like a living painting. Your evening concludes with a relaxing dinner at Cooinda Lodge, nestled in the heart of Kakadu, where you’ll dine surrounded by the sounds of the wilderness—an idyllic end to a truly magical day. This tour is a perfect blend of natural beauty, cultural discovery, and unforgettable experiences. Duration: Afternoon / Evening  Departure: 10:30am Tour Highlights: Yellow Water River Cruise: A spectacular 2-hour sunset cruise where you’ll witness breathtaking views, birds in flight, and crocodiles gliding across the water. Aboriginal Rock Art Site: Explore ancient Ngoulrlangie (Nourlangie) Rock Art, a vivid glimpse into the Dreaming and the stories of Kakadu’s first people. Wetlands Bird Hide: A birdwatcher’s paradise, where you can enjoy the peaceful beauty of the wetlands and their vibrant birdlife. Cultural Centre Visit: Delve deep into Kakadu’s cultural significance at the Bowali Aboriginal Cultural Centre, gaining insight into the region’s spiritual and historical importance. Dinner at Cooinda Lodge: End your day with a delicious dinner at the lodge, surrounded by the sounds and beauty of Kakadu’s wilderness. Experienced and Knowledgeable Tour Guide to bring Kakadu’s stunning landscapes and rich history to life. Comfortable Air-conditioned Vehicle: Travel in comfort as you explore Kakadu in style, with air-conditioning to keep you cool throughout the day. Kakadu Parks Pass: Entry to Kakadu National Park is included, allowing you access to this UNESCO World Heritage-listed treasure. Convenient Return Door-to-Door Transfers from Darwin, ensuring a smooth and stress-free journey. Itinerary: Our adventure begins at 10:30am, its a 3 hour drive through the lush landscapes of Kakadu National Park, your expert guide will offer fascinating insights into the natural and cultural wonders you’re about to encounter. Our first stop takes us to one of the park’s serene wetlands billabongs, a paradise for birdwatchers and wildlife enthusiasts. With a cool drink in hand, you’ll settle into the bird hide and be immersed in the quiet beauty of Kakadu’s wetlands. From this vantage point, you’ll spot a variety of monsoonal tropical birds—perhaps a majestic jabiru or an agile magpie goose—as well as fish and turtles gliding through the water. The tranquil atmosphere offers a perfect introduction to Kakadu's biodiversity and a peaceful start to the day. Aboriginal Rock Art Gallery: Kakadu is a treasure trove of ancient culture, the Aboriginal Rock Art Galleries are some of the oldest and most significant in the world, with paintings dating back over 20,000 years. You’ll be guided through one of the most renowned galleries, where ancient stories are etched in vibrant ochre on the rocks. These galleries are a testament to the deep connection to the indigenous people have with the land and its creatures. Aboriginal Cultural Centre: At the Cultural Centre in Kakadu National Park, you'll gain a deeper understanding of Aboriginal culture through the voices of the local Bininj/Mungguy people. The centre offers engaging exhibits on traditional customs, land management, bush foods, kinship, and the impacts of colonisation.),the centre provides an authentic and respectful space to explore Indigenous perspectives, storytelling, and connection to Country. Yellow Water River Cruise: In the afternoon, we’ll embark on the Yellow Water River Wildlife Cruise, one of the highlights of the tour. This award-winning cruise allows you to explore the heart of Kakadu’s wetlands in comfort, where the magic of the park truly comes alive. As you glide along the water, your guide will point out the many wildlife species that call this area home. You may spot crocodiles lounging on the banks, magnificent egrets soaring overhead, and flocks of colorful kingfishers darting across the water. The stillness of the river, surrounded by the vast wetlands, makes for an unforgettable experience. During the cruise, you’ll learn about the Indigenous people’s deep connection to the Yellow Water Billabong and the surrounding lands. These waterways have been central to their culture for thousands of years, providing food, water, and a spiritual link to the past. The boat glides effortlessly through these ancient landscapes, allowing you to truly appreciate their timeless beauty. Dinner at the Lodge: After an afternoon and evening of exploration, we’ll recharge with a delicious dinner at a local lodge. Here, you’ll enjoy a seasonal menu showcasing regional flavors, including fresh produce, meats, and unique Australian ingredients. Relax, enjoy the local atmosphere, and prepare for the drive home. Return to Accommodation: As the tour wraps up, we start our 3 hour drive back to your accommodation, your camera full of stunning photographs and your heart full of memories from one of Australia’s most remarkable national parks. Additional Information: Accessibility: The tour is designed to be suitable for most people, but the walk through the rock art galleries may include some uneven terrain. If you have mobility concerns, please let us know in advance. What to bring:                     - 1 to 1.5L re-fillable water bottle - Camera, Hat, Sunglasses - Insect Repellent & Sunscreen - Travel pillow to rest on the way to and from Kakadu.  - Guests are required to bring their own medication.  - A Jumper for the cooler months (May to August) Key points Low levels of fitness required 1 km walk on tour (*optional walks on tour call for a medium level of fitness, there are optional) Cancellations: A strict cancellation policy applies, we require at least 72 hours’ notice for a 100% refund.  All cancellations under72 hours will be a 100% cancellation fee.  In the unlikely event of the tour being cancelled by the operator, guests will be offered a full refund or an alternative day. ​What’s Included  Return Door-to-Door Transfers from Darwin Experienced Tour Guide Yellow Water River Cruise - 2 Hour Sunset Cruise Aboriginal Rock Art Site Wetlands Bird Hide Cutlural Centre Visit Lunch at the Tavern Dinner at the Lodge Comfortable Air-conditioned vehicle Kakadu Parks Pass What's excluded​​ Travel insurance is highly recommended Fitness Requirements   This experience calls for a low level of fitness, optional additional walks are graded as a medium level of fitness - these walks are optional.  Bookings can be made via phone, text, WhatsApp, or email without any booking fees by reaching out to us at 0411 926 186 or info@sacredowltours.com.au ​​ ​

Description & Content
description
Experience the natural beauty and excitement of K'gari (Fraser Island) with a 4wd Hire! (Starting price is for 2 people)  Additional people are priced at $90 per person up to 6, (please note we can only offer camping for 5 people, 6 people accommodation) Toyota Prado - automatic  Includes: 3 Days 4wd Hire, 4wd Safety Briefing and Personalised Itinerary. This is a 3 day 2 night self-drive 4wd experience to Fraser Island, with a personalised itinerary that coincides with the low tides on 75 Miles Beach (Fraser's Eastern Beach) where you can safely drive along to see the Maheno Shipwreck and the Coloured sands (Pinnacles), stopping at the famous Eli Creek. You can go as far as Indian Head and Champagne Pools in 3 days!  Inland, be mesmerised by Lake McKenzie and Lake Wabby, be amazed by the ancient ferns and rainforest at Central Station with still plenty of time to get the 3 or 5 pm barge! • Wanted to stay longer? : choose a 4 day 4wd hire. • Need more info? have a look at our General Hire Information. • Thinking of camping? Then choose our additional camp package at $120 per person for 2 nights (National Park Camp Permits are extra @ $10 per person per night) • Would prefer accommodation? We also have great accommodation options - Please call us for more information and we can book your accommodation on Fraser Island (0741256386) Your return (both ways) barge package of $280 will be added to your booking, you must add the $10 per person levy.  We will provide the details close to the departure to book the vehicle access permit from $58 Please note that our vehicles don't include aircon - this part of our commitment to the environment and reducing our carbon footprint - instead we help offset your carbon foot print by planting a tree for every car we hire! So you can be assured that when you chose a package with Fraser Dingo your helping protect Australia's beautiful natural heritage for generations to come!

detail_cancellation_policy
3 Day hires can only drive as far as Indian Heads on the Eastern Beach (280km limit) - all travel on the Eastern beach of Fraser Island is tide & weather dependent. All 4WD vehicle hire is restricted to 4WD hire map limits - these will be covered in your 4WD safety information session. We only require 1 or 2 drivers. All drivers must attend a 4WD safety information session prior to departure (takes approx 1.5hr). You must be over 25 years to hire the vehicle, 23 and over can drive, but we do not hire to groups where all participants are under 23 years. 4WD HIRE BOND: All 4wd vehicle hire packages are subject to a credit card bond of $2000 (groups 23 years & over) with an excess reduction of $4000 - $6000. Bond refunds are completed up to 48 hours after the vehicle is returned in hired condition and a mechanical check has been completed however it may take the bank 5-7 business days to release the bond.

Description & Content
description
Embark on a journey that promises to awaken your senses and immerse you in the beauty of Western Australia. Your adventure begins with a pick-up from your city accommodation, and from there, the world unfolds before your eyes. We'll take you north of Perth to Yanchep National Park, a sprawling natural oasis bursting with vibrant colours and native Australian wildlife. Here, you'll walk beneath the shade of towering trees, explore seasonal floral displays, and engage in bushwalks or bird watching in their natural habitat. Yanchep is a treasure trove of experiences, offering bushwalks, Aboriginal culture, heritage-listed buildings, underground caves, wildflowers in full bloom (from July to October), and serene wetlands. Dive into the depths of the Earth at the Crystal Cave, a subterranean wonderland adorned with natural cave formations like stalagmites, helicities, columns, and shawls. As you explore during a 45-minute journey, you'll discover the cave's rich history, geology, and the thriving ecosystem within. Leaving Yanchep behind, we head south to Hillarys, renowned for its marina, shopping precinct, and the famous AQWA Aquarium. Enjoy the tranquillity of Neil Hawkins Park, where native Australian birds, including parrots and cockatoos, fill the air with their vibrant presence. Take in the serene beauty of the lake, where you might even spot some fish swimming beneath the surface. Hillarys Boat Harbour welcomes you with open arms, providing a premier recreational destination since its inception in 1988. Whether you're seeking retail therapy for fashion, surf wear, crafts, souvenirs, or authentic Australiana, or simply craving a delightful meal at the café and restaurant strip, you'll find it here. For an added adventure, dive into the depths of the ocean at AQWA - The Aquarium of Western Australia. This captivating experience features live coral displays and the world's largest collection of Western Australian marine life. Marvel at an array of fish, turtles, seahorses, sharks, and more as you journey along the Western Australian coast. Get up close and personal with starfish and baby sharks at the child-friendly discovery pool, and witness the wonder of one of the world's largest living coral reef exhibits. Your journey through Western Australia will leave you with treasured memories and a deeper connection to the region's natural wonders. Don't miss this opportunity to unearth a world of marvels.

Leaving Yanchep behind, we head south to Hillarys, renowned for its marina, shopping precinct, and the famous AQWA Aquarium. Enjoy the tranquillity of Neil Hawkins Park, where native Australian birds, including parrots and cockatoos, fill the air with their vibrant presence. Take in the serene beauty of the lake, where you might even spot some fish swimming beneath the surface. Hillarys Boat Harbour welcomes you with open arms, providing a premier recreational destination since its inception in 1988. Whether you're seeking retail therapy for fashion, surf wear, crafts, souvenirs, or authentic Australiana, or simply craving a delightful meal at the café and restaurant strip, you'll find it here. For an added adventure, dive into the depths of the ocean at AQWA - The Aquarium of Western Australia. This captivating experience features live coral displays and the world's largest collection of Western Australian marine life. Marvel at an array of fish, turtles, seahorses, sharks, and more as you journey along the Western Australian coast. Get up close and personal with starfish and baby sharks at the child-friendly discovery pool, and witness the wonder of one of the world's largest living coral reef exhibits. Your journey through Western Australia will leave you with treasured memories and a deeper connection to the region's natural wonders. Don't miss this opportunity to unearth a world of marvels.
detail_highlights
Explore Yanchep National Park, engage in bushwalks or bird watching, visit the Crystal Cave, enjoy Hillarys Boat Harbour, experience AQWA - The Aquarium of Western Australia, see live coral displays and Western Australian marine life.

detail_cancellation_policy
Upon purchasing this flight or gift voucher, you are agreeing to the Global Ballooning Terms & Conditions, as stipulated on our website - https://www.globalballooning.com.au/terms-conditions/ Important key points: Changes to bookings: Changes made between 7 days and 48 hours before your flight incur a $50 per person fee. Within 48 hours: No changes or cancellations are permitted within 48 hours of your scheduled flight. No-shows: If you do not arrive for your flight, your booking will be forfeited, and refunds or rescheduling are not possible. Full-priced tickets may be refunded (less a $25 admin fee per transaction) if requested within 6 months of purchase. After 6 months, no refunds are available. Refunds may incur additional fees depending on your payment method. Full-priced gift vouchers are non-refundable and valid for 3 years. Discounted tickets / vouchers are strictly non-refundable. They are valid only for the period stated at the time of booking (shown on your voucher / booking details link). If your flight is cancelled, please ensure you rebook within that validity period. Group bookings have separate terms and conditions, which will be provided in writing to the primary contact before confirmation. Easy Access Basket bookings also have separate terms and conditions, which will be provided in writing before confirmation. Ballooning is a weather-dependent activity, and flights may occasionally be cancelled to ensure passenger safety. Flights may also be cancelled if minimum passenger numbers are not met.

detail_health_safety
Hot Air Ballooning is an outdoor adventure activity that involves some active participation from passengers and as such a minimum level of fitness and well-being is required. By noting your agreement and completing this booking, you will notify us if members of your booking party have: significant knee, hip, back or neck problems; any other existing conditions that would preclude them from following the pilot's instructions, including assuming the semi-sitting landing positions with knees bent; absorbing a bumpy, firm or tip over landing, or any impairment that would prevent them from holding on to the hand holds upon landing; any surgeries or broken bones within the past 6 months; or are currently under doctors supervision regarding surgery or injury, regardless of when it occurred; the inability to stand for one hour unassisted; Or is currently pregnant in the 3rd trimester. We will fly passengers in the 1st and 2nd trimester; however, please notify us prior to your flight date. If you have any concerns regarding being Fit to Fly - please speak to our office or your health professional.

Description & Content
description
duration: 2.5 Hours meeting_point: Departing from the Port Chalmers Cruise Terminal group_size: Maximum 16 people accessibility: Not suitable for wheelchairs description: # Find out why Dunedin is the Wildlife Capital of NZ! We’ll pick you up from the Port Chalmers Cruise Ship Terminal and shuttle you 5-minutes to our boat, the Vivienne J. Once aboard the boat our local crew of nature enthusiasts will take you for a Wildlife Cruise on the Otago Harbour and beyond. The small-group cruise will travel past beautiful wharves, boatsheds and the historic Quarantine Island. You’ll see the Careys Bay fishing village and its motley collection of fishing boats before continuing down the harbour. Your crew will put the kettle on and offer you a hot drink and biscuit for morning tea. As you arrive at the entrance to the Otago Harbour you’ll see the tidal Aramoana sandflats and the spectacular volcanic cliffs of Taiaroa Head. You’ll see the royal albatross breeding colony, the only mainland colony in the world. Beneath a picturesque lighthouse you’ll find a large population of fur seals, watch as they swim, play and sleep on rocky platforms close to the boat. A short way out to sea we often spot other species of albatross and seabirds. We sometimes get lucky and see dolphins, sea lions and blue penguins. ## What to bring: Dress warm for the days forecast and bring a waterproof layer. The weather can be unpredictable at times and we highly recommend being ready for all conditions. Extra jackets are available if needed. We suggest wearing sturdy and comfortable footwear. You are welcome to bring your own food and drink on the boat. Don’t forget your camera! check_in_details: Make your way to the ‘Private Tours Area’ within the Port Chalmers Cruise Ship Terminal. It is located approximately 100-metres from where you disembark your ship. You will be collected by a member of our team holding a MONARCH sign. Once everyone booked has arrived they'll shuttle you around to our wharf to board the MV Vivienne J. At the end of the tour you'll be dropped back at the Port Chalmers Cruise Terminal.

detail_description
Find out why Dunedin is the Wildlife Capital of NZ! We’ll pick you up from the Port Chalmers Cruise Ship Terminal and shuttle you 5-minutes to our boat, the Vivienne J. Once aboard the boat our local crew of nature enthusiasts will take you for a Wildlife Cruise on the Otago Harbour and beyond. The small-group cruise will travel past beautiful wharves, boatsheds and the historic Quarantine Island. You’ll see the Careys Bay fishing village and its motley collection of fishing boats before continuing down the harbour. Your crew will put the kettle on and offer you a hot drink and biscuit for morning tea. As you arrive at the entrance to the Otago Harbour you’ll see the tidal Aramoana sandflats and the spectacular volcanic cliffs of Taiaroa Head. You’ll see the royal albatross breeding colony, the only mainland colony in the world. Beneath a picturesque lighthouse you’ll find a large population of fur seals, watch as they swim, play and sleep on rocky platforms close to the boat. A short way out to sea we often spot other species of albatross and seabirds. We sometimes get lucky and see dolphins, sea lions and blue penguins. What to bring: Dress warm for the days forecast and bring a waterproof layer. The weather can be unpredictable at times and we highly recommend being ready for all conditions. Extra jackets are available if needed. We suggest wearing sturdy and comfortable footwear. You are welcome to bring your own food and drink on the boat. Don’t forget your camera!
detail_highlights
See the royal albatross breeding colony, the only mainland colony in the world. Watch fur seals swim, play, and sleep on rocky platforms close to the boat. Spot other species of albatross and seabirds, and occasionally dolphins, sea lions, and blue penguins.
detail_itinerary
We’ll pick you up from the Port Chalmers Cruise Ship Terminal and shuttle you 5-minutes to our boat, the Vivienne J. Once aboard the boat our local crew of nature enthusiasts will take you for a Wildlife Cruise on the Otago Harbour and beyond. The small-group cruise will travel past beautiful wharves, boatsheds and the historic Quarantine Island. You’ll see the Careys Bay fishing village and its motley collection of fishing boats before continuing down the harbour. As you arrive at the entrance to the Otago Harbour you’ll see the tidal Aramoana sandflats and the spectacular volcanic cliffs of Taiaroa Head.
detail_what_is_not_included
You are welcome to bring your own food and drink on the boat.

Booking & Cancellation
booking_notes
##Thank you for booking a Otago Harbour Wildlife Cruise. ___ *High quality binoculars and multi-language information sheets will be provided aboard the cruise.* *Dress warm for the days forecast and bring a waterproof layer. The weather can be unpredictable at times and we highly recommend being ready for all conditions. Extra jackets are available if needed.* *We suggest wearing sturdy and comfortable footwear. If you decide to stand whilst on the boat always have a hand free to stabilise yourself on a rail. Take extra care when moving around the vessel.* *The area we cruise around is fairly sheltered from swell, however some wind and tide combinations can cause a little rock and roll. Don’t worry if the forecast is for a cold, wet or windy day, the albatross love it. They won’t stop for rain and neither do we. The best viewing often comes from the wilder days.* *Wildlife viewing isn’t guaranteed, but we’ll always aim to provide the best possible experience.* *Toilet and bathroom facilities are available during the Wildlife Cruise* *If you are concerned about potential sea sickness, a variety of preventative medications can be purchased at local pharmacies. Our crew can also provide pressure pressure point wristbands and peppermint oil pads if you begin to feel queasy or uneasy (they really do help).* You may be photographed and/or videotaped during your cruise or tour. Your image may be used for promotional and informational purposes, including online publications/media and tour documentation The recording of videography and or photography for the purposes of commercial gain is expressly forbidden without prior written permission from management. --- [View Otago Harbour Wildlife Cruise.pdf](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/VQhPh4MRwCGREolAwxGI)
booking_notes_safe_html
Thank you for booking a Otago Harbour Wildlife Cruise. High quality binoculars and multi-language information sheets will be provided aboard the cruise. Dress warm for the days forecast and bring a waterproof layer. The weather can be unpredictable at times and we highly recommend being ready for all conditions. Extra jackets are available if needed. We suggest wearing sturdy and comfortable footwear. If you decide to stand whilst on the boat always have a hand free to stabilise yourself on a rail. Take extra care when moving around the vessel. The area we cruise around is fairly sheltered from swell, however some wind and tide combinations can cause a little rock and roll. Don’t worry if the forecast is for a cold, wet or windy day, the albatross love it. They won’t stop for rain and neither do we. The best viewing often comes from the wilder days. Wildlife viewing isn’t guaranteed, but we’ll always aim to provide the best possible experience. Toilet and bathroom facilities are available during the Wildlife Cruise If you are concerned about potential sea sickness, a variety of preventative medications can be purchased at local pharmacies. Our crew can also provide pressure pressure point wristbands and peppermint oil pads if you begin to feel queasy or uneasy (they really do help). You may be photographed and/or videotaped during your cruise or tour. Your image may be used for promotional and informational purposes, including online publications/media and tour documentation The recording of videography and or photography for the purposes of commercial gain is expressly forbidden without prior written permission from management. View Otago Harbour Wildlife Cruise.pdf
cancellation_policy
We will arrange a full refund if your ship doesn’t arrive in Dunedin, or if it is late to berth and you miss the tour. Cancellations made more than 24 hours prior to the scheduled tour start time will be given a full refund. Any cancellations within 24 hours will not be issued a refund. If we cancel the tour for any reason (e.g inclement weather) we will provide a full refund.

Get creative and then enjoy a movie @ Eldorado United Cinemas Adults make and paint 2 pieces with 2 x 500 grams of clay on the wheel. Kids make and paint 2 pieces with 2 x 250 grams of clay on the wheel. You will also receive a gift voucher to see any movie @ Eldorado United Cinemas (G-Max Recliner Seats). Work with our experienced teacher for up to 2 hours on the wheel and finish by painting your piece in the same session.

Description & Content
description
duration: One day meeting_point: - group_size: Maximum 9 people description: Our shuttle service is designed to save time with transport and equipment logistics and increase your time on the water. MORE THAN JUST A SHUTTLE & EQUIPMENT HIRE 👉 Boyd River and Nymboida River shuttles. 👉 We have in house over 35 years experience on the Boyd and Nymboida rivers and can explain each section as well as give you the latest updates. 👉 We monitor your tour to make sure you are where you should be at that time, and we also monitor rain and river heights whilst you are on the river and send you updates. 👉 We hire more that just canoes with an extensive list of camping, satellite, and rescue equipment for hire. 👉 An experienced guide will give you a safety and river skill talk before you get on the water 👉 Exclusive river access to numerous private properties that run along the Nymboida River. 👉 We have 11 seater troopies, 24 seater bus, multiple canoe trailers as well as one trailer that can carry 12 canoes and 36 barrels. 👉 Half or full day whitewater training sessions before your trip or as a part of your dry hire. **IF THE RIVER IS TOO HIGH WE WILL NOT HIRE TO YOU.** **Please ensure you read our Hire Policy & Conditions & Rescue & Recovery Policy before booking - By confirming and paying for your booking, you agree to these policies.** **WATERPROOFING** ❑ High quality garbage bags (eg Multix Garden Drawtight Garbage Bags) for waterproofing your 60L canoe barrel. ❑ Spare large clip seal bags for waterproofing your personal items 👉 Please note dry bags do not fit into canoe barrels efficiently. Please email or call **0410 404 078** if you are interested in using our 24 seater bus for a shuttle. ## Explore Australia’s the Longest-Mapped Whitewater Trail The Clarence Canoe & Kayak Trail is the longest mapped whitewater trail in Australia – covering more than 195km of river between Nymboi-Binderay National Park and the township of Copmanhurst – and contains some of the most diverse paddling conditions found anywhere in the world. (https://www.myclarencevalley.com/clarence-canoe-and-kayak-trail/) If you have any questions or would like more information please email [admin@exodusadventures.com.au](mailto:admin@exodusadventures.com.au) or give us a call on [0410 404 078](callto:+61410404078) what_is_included: Each shuttle can take up to 9 people per vehicle, which includes craft and equipment. You can either drive to us and leave your vehicle secure with us at our Exodus Base in Buccarumbi (end of section 2 and start of section 3) and we take you to your location or you can park your vehicle at a location, and we will transfer you and your equipment to Buccarumbi. itinerary: We can help you create the perfect escape into nature. * River Information * Rescue & Boat Recovery * Whitewater Training * Over 35 years of whitewater experience check_in_details: Satellite tracking is required on all canoe hires. If you do not have your own satellite tracking device where you can share your tracking link with us, you will need to hire our InReach (or a 3rd party hire company) in order for your booking to go ahead. Please note that due to the rivers being a natural flow river system river heights can change rapidly. Having a alternative backup plan is a must. special_requirements: ###SHUTTLE PICKUPS Please plan your trip to be off the water, considering travel time from your pull off location to be back at our Exodus Property by 5pm. ##Set pickup times for these locations are • Jackadgery: 3pm • Nymboida River Campground: 3:30pm extras: Camping and cooking equipment available for hire. Other locations for Transfers / Shuttles available on request. disclaimers: ###Rescue & Recovery Policy A minimum call-out fee of $600 applies for any rescue, evacuation, or boat recovery required during your hire period. Additional charges may apply depending on: • Location and accessibility • Time and resources required • Equipment retrieval or damage • After-hours or multi-day recovery By hiring equipment, you acknowledge and accept responsibility for these potential costs. ###Hire Policy & Conditions By confirming and paying for your booking, you agree to the following hire and use terms and conditions: • As the hirer, you are responsible for checking the gear upon collection, ensuring you have the necessary skills for the intended river section, and returning the equipment in good condition. • Hirer pays for replacement (at current retail market price) for any items hired that is damage/broken/loss/stolen beyond that might constitute fair and reasonable wear and tear. • Assumes full responsibility for the safety and security of the equipment from the time of its removal from, to the time of its return to Exodus Adventures’ premises or representative. • Acknowledges that insurance cover of the equipment is not held by Exodus Adventures for the duration of the hire and that any such insurance cover is the sole responsibility of the hirer. • Acknowledges that canoeing is an activity that can involve significant risk of injury or death and accepts responsibility for ensuring that all users of the equipment have the necessary skills, training and experience to safely use or operate it during the period of the hire. • Will make no claims whatsoever against Exodus Adventures, either in relation to any advice provided by Exodus Adventures’ or its agent, or in relation to the use of the Equipment by the hirer or by any user of the equipment during the period of the hire, with or without the knowledge or consent of the hirer. • Children under 18 years must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

detail_description
Our shuttle service is designed to save time with transport and equipment logistics and increase your time on the water. MORE THAN JUST A SHUTTLE & EQUIPMENT HIRE 👉 Boyd River and Nymboida River shuttles. 👉 We have in house over 35 years experience on the Boyd and Nymboida rivers and can explain each section as well as give you the latest updates. 👉 We monitor your tour to make sure you are where you should be at that time, and we also monitor rain and river heights whilst you are on the river and send you updates. 👉 We hire more that just canoes with an extensive list of camping, satellite, and rescue equipment for hire. 👉 An experienced guide will give you a safety and river skill talk before you get on the water 👉 Exclusive river access to numerous private properties that run along the Nymboida River. 👉 We have 11 seater troopies, 24 seater bus, multiple canoe trailers as well as one trailer that can carry 12 canoes and 36 barrels. 👉 Half or full day whitewater training sessions before your trip or as a part of your dry hire. IF THE RIVER IS TOO HIGH WE WILL NOT HIRE TO YOU. Please ensure you read our Hire Policy & Conditions & Rescue & Recovery Policy before booking - By confirming and paying for your booking, you agree to these policies. WATERPROOFING ❑ High quality garbage bags (eg Multix Garden Drawtight Garbage Bags) for waterproofing your 60L canoe barrel. ❑ Spare large clip seal bags for waterproofing your personal items 👉 Please note dry bags do not fit into canoe barrels efficiently. Please email or call 0410 404 078 if you are interested in using our 24 seater bus for a shuttle. Explore Australia’s the Longest-Mapped Whitewater Trail The Clarence Canoe & Kayak Trail is the longest mapped whitewater trail in Australia – covering more than 195km of river between Nymboi-Binderay National Park and the township of Copmanhurst – and contains some of the most diverse paddling conditions found anywhere in the world. (https://www.myclarencevalley.com/clarence-canoe-and-kayak-trail/) If you have any questions or would like more information please email admin@exodusadventures.com.au or give us a call on 0410 404 078
detail_highlights
Boyd River and Nymboida River shuttles. We have in house over 35 years experience on the Boyd and Nymboida rivers and can explain each section as well as give you the latest updates. We monitor your tour to make sure you are where you should be at that time, and we also monitor rain and river heights whilst you are on the river and send you updates. We hire more that just canoes with an extensive list of camping, satellite, and rescue equipment for hire. An experienced guide will give you a safety and river skill talk before you get on the water. Exclusive river access to numerous private properties that run along the Nymboida River. We have 11 seater troopies, 24 seater bus, multiple canoe trailers as well as one trailer that can carry 12 canoes and 36 barrels. Half or full day whitewater training sessions before your trip or as a part of your dry hire.

detail_description
Take a tour of our snowdrop plantings with Margaret Barker. She wishes to share her passion and knowledge of the snowdrops which she has collected for the Castle Garden over the last 58 years. Margaret will share growing tips, best times to shift and divide and how to help snowdrops thrive in your own garden. Following Margaret’s tour, you are invited to join her for an afternoon tea in the lower veranda where there will be opportunity to ask questions and mingle with likeminded people over a bite to eat and a cuppa.
detail_highlights
Margaret will share growing tips, best times to shift and divide and how to help snowdrops thrive in your own garden. Join her for an afternoon tea in the lower veranda where there will be opportunity to ask questions and mingle with likeminded people over a bite to eat and a cuppa.

Booking & Cancellation
booking_notes
Thank you for booking our upcoming “Wander down the narrow paths” tour with Margaret Barker. We look forward to having you join us at Larnach Castle and Gardens to celebrate our annual Snowdrop day celebrations. Please make your way to the bottom of the main stairs in the front of the Castle 5 minutes before your tour start time and show this confirmation to one of our team members as proof of purchase to join the tour group. Following your tour, please join Margaret in the lower veranda of the Castle for afternoon tea where there will be opportunity to mingle and ask questions with other like-minded visitors. If you haven't already, please let us know by email at reservations@larnachcastle.co.nz, or by phone 03 476 1616, of any **special dietary requirements** (e.g. vegetarian, gluten free, allergies) that your group may have. Don’t forget we will also have a plant stand open with a selection of plants available for purchase on the day and our giftshop will be open and full of wonderful homewares, jewellery, skincare and much more. We hope you enjoy your day and thank you again for visiting us. The Team at Larnach Castle To learn more about your visit to Larnach Castle, please [visit our website](https://www.larnachcastle.co.nz/Plan-your-visit-to-Larnach-Castle)

cancellation_policy
Cancellations - there is a 10% cancellation fee until 48 hours before the event. Cancellations after this incur a 100% cancellation fee. Amendments and Cancellations - please contact the Castle directly if you need to amend the date of your visit or cancel. Requests to amend or cancel must be received by 4pm the day prior to your visit.

Description & Content
description
#We love telling stories and sharing them with our guests; this time, it's all about our younger visitors. ##Duration 30 minutes ##About We've designed a special tour for children visiting the Knights of the Sky (WW1) exhibition. Each tour lasts 30 minutes, and during that time, we've picked out the best stories to engage young minds. We aim to have fun and learn something at the same time! The tour is best suited to children aged between 5-8 years old. Once the tour is finished, visitors are welcome to pop out, enjoy a snack in the cafe, and return to see anything they missed. Each V.I.Y.P (very important young person) will receive a souvenir of their visit.

booking_notes
##Important This tour is aimed at children aged 5-8 years old. All children must be accompanied by an adult. Accompanying adults will be charged $15 for entry & the tour. This is a tour for children; therefore, only adults accompanying their child can book this tour. Upon completion of the tour, guests are free to spend extra time in the exhibition. Please ensure to dress warmly. On a cold day, it can be a little chilly in the museum. Thank you!

Description & Content
description
description: #Join us on a 6 day expedition deep into the Fiordland National Park, with an epic 2 nights out on the fiords. (Where possible). Watch out for seals, penguins, and more. #Please note that the overnight stays on the Fiords are strictly subject to availability at time of booking, and may vary between operators. If not available we will still undertake day trips with additional land based accommodation. If the land based accommodation works out cheaper, we will either refund the difference, or provide alternative activities with an equivalent value ##Duration 6 Days ##About Admire, photograph, and enjoy not just one fiord, but two, in one expedition. From Christchurch we had for Queenstown via Aoraki Mt Cook, and then into Milford Sound / Piopiotahi and Te Anau before exploring Doubtful Sound / Patea. Both fiords include a cruise and where possible we overnight on both as well. There is the chance of a mountain helicopter flight to tempt your taste buds too. ##Itinerary: ###Day 1: Christchurch to Queenstown. Today we work our way south via Lake Tekapo and the Lindis Pass to Queenstown in the heart of the Otago-Lakes District, and a perfect jumping off spot for our foray into the Fiordland National Park. Along the way soak up the views of big mountains, magical lakes, and the ever spectacular Kawarau gorge before arriving Queenstown ###Day 2: Queenstown to Milford Sound: Our Fiordland Journey begins in earnest. Departing early for Milford Sound, we arrive in time to board our over-night vessel*, late afternoon. Once out on the water, there is nothing to stop the spectacular scenery assaulting your senses. A nature lovers and photographers delight which ever way you turn. Towering mile high seacliffs, and a fiord that is over 300m deep in places *If the overnight cruise is unavailable then we will still enjoy a day cruise on Milford Sound, before retreating to Te Anau for the night ###Day 3: Milford Sound to Te Anau: Post overnight in Milford Sound, we have the rest of the day to work our way back to Te Anau, where we pick up our accommodation for the night. If time and daylight permits, (Or if we missed out on the overnight trip on Milford Sound) there may be a (optional extra) helicopter flight, weather permitting, for those inclined to do so – The Fiordland Mountains from the air? Magnificent! ###Day 4: Te Anau to Doubtful Sound: After a leisurely start (or you can get up early and photograph the sunrise as it plays across the mountains and lake in front of you!) we depart mid-morning for Lake Manapouri, and Pearl Harbour at it’s southern end. Departing Pearl Harbour at 12:00, we take boat across Lake Manapouri, and after a stunning bus ride over Wilmot Pass, we drop down into Deep Cove – one of the many arms of Doubtful Sound, where we join our next over-night vessel, (Subject to availability) for another jaw-dropping over-night experience. Note as per Milford Sound, if the overnight option is not available for Doubtful Sound, we will still do a day cruise, with a return to Te Anau that evening. ###Day 5: Doubtful Sound to Queenstown: We return from our over-night excursion late morning. After stopping once more in Te Anau, we make our way back to Queenstown for another night whilst once again enjoying the scenery around us. With a bit more time this afternoon, we can take more time to enjoy some of the sights we bypassed on our way to Milford Sound a few days ago. Arriving back in Queenstown late afternoon, we can further explore the lakeside town before settling in for the night ###Day 6: Queenstown to Christchurch: Today we make our way back to Christchurch, in much the same direction as our outwards path, taking in more of the sights that we might have missed the first time. Lunch in Lake Tekapo? Nothing like it. We reluctantly arrive back in Christchurch mid-late afternoon. ##Inclusions: - Pickup from some of the main hotels within Christchurch, or alternately from the Canterbury Museum - Expert, knowledgeable guide - Activities and Permits - Photography tuition (if required) - Late model, air conditioned transport - All meals including lunch, dinner, breakfast* - Accommodation* - Overnight Milford Sound cruise if possible** - Day Cruise on Milford Sound and stay Te Anau if not - Overnight Doubtful Sound cruise if possible** - Day Cruise on Doubtful Sound and stay Te Anau if not - Snacks, beverages, and drinks - Scenic stops *Meals & Accommodation are available on Premium only. Please select "Premium" when booking (Does not apply to overnight cruises which are included on all options) **Overnight cruise on both Fiords is subject to availability at time of booking ##Optional Extras: - Scenic Helicopter Flight: Mountain Magic (40 min flight, $420 per person, Min of 2 people) with Southern Lakes Helicopters - Jet Boat Ride: Pure Wilderness (2 hours, $189 per person) with Fiordland Jet

Departing early for Milford Sound, we arrive in time to board our over-night vessel*, late afternoon. Once out on the water, there is nothing to stop the spectacular scenery assaulting your senses. After stopping once more in Te Anau, we make our way back to Queenstown for another night whilst once again enjoying the scenery around us. cancellation_policy
#All cancellations are subject to item 4, below. ###(1) If cancelled by you, our guest: **Half and Full Day Tours:** - Cancelled at least 7 days prior to departure: Full refund less $100 admin fee - Cancelled between 7 and 2 days prior to departure: Loss of deposit - Cancelled within 2 days of travel or no-show: No refund/Full payment required **Overnight Tours:** - Cancelled at least 14 days prior to departure: Full refund less $200 admin fee - Cancelled between 14 and 7 days prior to departure: Loss of deposit - Cancelled within 7 days of travel or no-show: No refund/Full Payment required **Three Day Tours:** - Cancelled at least 21 days prior to departure: Full refund less $300 admin fee - Cancelled between 21 and 14 days prior to departure: Loss of deposit - Cancelled within 14 days of travel or no-show: No refund/Full Payment required **Multi-day & Custom (Bespoke) Tours:** - Cancelled at least 60 days prior to departure: Full refund less $600 admin fee - Cancelled between 60 and 30 days prior to departure: Loss of deposit - Cancelled within 30 days of travel or no-show: No refund/Full Payment required ###(2) If cancelled by us: - If your tour is cancelled by us due to weather or operational issues, we reserve the right to offer you a substitute tour in the first instance, otherwise we will offer a full refund. - Where the tour is cancelled after departure by us we reserve the right to only refund the unused portion of your tour unless we have cancelled due to unacceptable/illegal behaviour on your part. ###(3) All cancellations must be in writing. If you cancel your tour any refund due, from us to you will be subject to these cancellation terms & conditions ###(4) Please note: that in all cases we may have pre-paid our providers in part or in full for their services in relation to your booking with us at the time that you cancel. In this instance we will endeavour to get a refund from our providers either in full or in part. If we are unable, or only partly able, to get a refund the difference will be offset against any refund due to you from us

description
duration: 4 hrs & 15 mins meeting_point: Eastern Pontoon, Circular Quay accessibility: Wheelchair access description: Step aboard for an unforgettable afternoon of music, memories and harbour views as Tribal Warrior and GV Entertainment present Queens of the King & The Sound Guy live on Sydney Harbour. Featuring the sensational ShElvis and Platinum Elvis, this high-energy tribute show celebrates the timeless hits of Elvis Presley, performed by powerhouse vocalists who bring charisma, glamour and stage presence to every note. Cruise past the iconic Sydney Harbour backdrop while enjoying a lively lunch atmosphere filled with classic rock ‘n’ roll favourites, audience interaction and plenty of dancing opportunities. This is more than a cruise — it’s a floating concert experience. Boarding: 11:30am Cruising: 11:45am – 4:00pm check_in_details: Please be prepared to board the vessel at 11:30am, sharp

detail_description
Step aboard for an unforgettable afternoon of music, memories and harbour views as Tribal Warrior and GV Entertainment present Queens of the King & The Sound Guy live on Sydney Harbour. Featuring the sensational ShElvis and Platinum Elvis, this high-energy tribute show celebrates the timeless hits of Elvis Presley, performed by powerhouse vocalists who bring charisma, glamour and stage presence to every note. Cruise past the iconic Sydney Harbour backdrop while enjoying a lively lunch atmosphere filled with classic rock ‘n’ roll favourites, audience interaction and plenty of dancing opportunities. This is more than a cruise — it’s a floating concert experience. Boarding: 11:30am Cruising: 11:45am – 4:00pm
detail_highlights

Cruise past the iconic Sydney Harbour backdrop while enjoying a lively lunch atmosphere filled with classic rock ‘n’ roll favourites, audience interaction and plenty of dancing opportunities. This is more than a cruise — it’s a floating concert experience.
